correctness.rationale: The quadratic normal form in ambient independent local coordinates (x,y,p) has symmetric matrix M and 4det M=D. Gauss lemma in the disjoint Q,U,V variables makes D irreducible: over Frac C[w,U,V], it is a rank-(m+1)>=4 affine quadric, and its coefficient gcd is one. Since p=sum P_i^2 is irreducible over Frac(C[w,Q,U,V]/(D)), (p,D) is prime and a (2,4) complete intersection in P^(4m), degree 8. On u w!=0, completion of squares gives 4uH=(2ux+vy)^2+u(2p-wy)^2+Dy^2; the two corank-one lines are exchanged by sqrt(-u/w^2). On w=1, v^2=u(4q-1), and independent square classes of the irreducibles u and 4q-1 show u is not square in the quadric function field; other P,V coordinates are purely transcendental. The étale double cover is therefore connected on a dense smooth open. Independent sympy determinant and polynomial expansion confirm critical identities, not nonsquareness alone.
